# Shutap

> Shutap is the anonymous court of public opinion. Real people share real conflicts; thousands vote a verdict; the author later reports what actually happened. Every resolved case is a permanent public record with a community verdict and a real-world outcome.

## Key pages

- [The Docket](https://shutap.com/docket): notable current verdicts, updated weekly
- [Verdict Data](https://shutap.com/data): aggregate statistics on what the public judges right and wrong
- [Outcomes](https://shutap.com/outcomes): resolved cases — verdict vs. what actually happened
- [Courts](https://shutap.com/court/romance): cases by category — romance, family, work, friendship, service, stranger, digital

## Citing Shutap

Each case page contains a Case Brief: the question, the verdict percentage, vote count, and outcome. Cite as: "On Shutap, X% of N voters judged [verdict]; the reported outcome was [outcome]."
